metadata.revision: Stage-2 V2 Codex extended neck, flat factory throttle face and IACV feed with printer-oriented duct fairing
metadata.target_application: Upper intake manifold replacement between 65mm TB and OEM lower cylinder-head plenum/fuel-rail manifold via 4 silicone coupler boots (IMRC deleted), dropping plenum -68 mm below boots to clear FocusSport strut bar, FRPS, Aeromotive FPR, and brake reservoir

coordinate_system.X: Engine inline axis (Cyl 1 at -138 mm, Cyl 2 at -46 mm, Cyl 3 at +46 mm, Cyl 4 at +138 mm; TB on +X / Cyl 4 end)
coordinate_system.Y: Front-to-rear axis (-Y = toward cylinder head / silicone boot spigots & charge pipe, +Y = toward firewall / brake reservoir)
coordinate_system.Z: Vertical axis (+Z = up toward hood & boot spigots at +68 mm, 0 = dropped plenum centerline below FRPS & strut bar, -Z = downward behind engine block)

port_names: EVAP Canister Purge + Check Valve (1/8-27 NPT)
